name: Ori no Naka no Watashi
source:
Girl Nao is taken from an orphanage and has a happy childhood with father-in-law, mother-in-law and sister-in-law. But it only lasts until the day her step-father abuses her on the exit from the bathroom. Nao decides to accept her obscene fate. Can she ever find true happiness?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
少女嵩邑奈绪被人从孤儿院接走，与养父、养母和养姐妹度过了一段幸福的童年。然而这份幸福只维持到某一天：奈绪刚从浴室出来，便遭到养父侵犯。她决定接受这淫乱的命运，可自己是否还有可能找到真正的幸福？

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
